lobby.invite: 📲 Everyone plays on their OWN phone: tap Invite in the top bar, send the link, and friends appear here as they open it.
scores.title: Scores
done.title: Round {n} done!
setup.title: One phone, everyone plays
setup.intro: Everyone gets the same secret word — except one imposter with a near-miss word. One clue each, out loud. Then point at the faker! 3+ players.
setup.lobbyText: Tap Invite in the top bar. Friends appear here; each phone peeks its own word — no passing.
deal.peek: Hold to peek at your secret word
talk.title: Clue time — phone down!
talk.body: In this order, everyone says one word or short phrase about their secret word. Specific enough to prove you know it, vague enough to hide it from the imposter. Then argue!
vote.title: On three, point at your suspect!
vote.body: Count it out loud. Whoever gets the most fingers is accused — tap them:
reveal.imposterWins: The imposter wins this round (+3). The words were “{a}” vs “{b}”.
reveal.lastChance: Last chance, {imp}: say the group's word OUT LOUD. Group — did they get it?
net.peek: Hold to peek — your secret word
net.clues: One clue each, out loud. Discuss. Then vote below — votes stay hidden until everyone's in.
net.wordsCaught: Words: “{a}” vs “{b}”. {imp}: say the group's word out loud — group taps the result.
